## Notes

- D01 and D04's right panel, and D03, all derive from the same underlying per-flight live-RMSE-by-window values (`scores/E4_<trial>_w<W>.json`), but encode them three different ways (D01: x = compute time, one line per flight; D04(b): x = window category, absolute value; D03: x = window category, change from the 0.25 s value, split by tag count) - kept as three candidates because each answers a different reading of the brief (compute-vs-error; the approved two-panel trade-off; the per-condition directional test), not because any one shows new data.
- D02 and D04's left panel are the same box-plot content (step time per window); D04 is kept as its own candidate only because the brief names the two-panel compute/accuracy figure as a user-approved exception in its own right.
- D05-D07 are the three panels of one source chart (`ex_E6_map_reuse.png`), split per the brief's 'separate plots, each with its own caption' instruction; the summary page 20 version only has the D05/D06 panels (a 2-panel subset), not a fourth candidate.
- D08 is the only ablation chart in either source document; its walkthrough page is a full-page embed of the summary page's own figure, so one candidate covers both.
- D08's pointer is `P2 (with heading); P3 (descriptive)`, not P1: the chart plots the WITH-HEADING arm of every rung (`ABR['runs'][...].heading`), and P1 (the no-heading control) is scored on a different, unplotted dataset - its n_within counts would not describe this figure's own data. P3's in-caption counts (r6 vs r0, r7 vs r3, 'within its control band') are recomputed from the same stored per-bag flags P3 uses, filtered to the 3 line-textured bags this figure actually draws, not the headline 4/6 and 2/6 counts (which also cover 3 unplotted plain-wall bags).
- every number in a caption is cross-checked, not only numbers drawn on the plotted image (the save_fig() number guard scans both); several of the file-provenance ('shown') checks tie a quoted range or threshold back to its exact source sentence (docs/thesis/tier1/e4_results.md, e6_results.md, e6_preregistration.md:208, docs/thesis/ablation/ablation_numbers.md, preregistration.md), the same role as the upstream scripts' `shown=` parameter.
